hero.subtitle: About Ozturksoft
hero.desc: We don't just develop software; we build the digital character of businesses.

story.p1: Ozturksoft was founded in Ankara as a tech company in line with our founders Samet OZTURK and Yusuf OZTURK's vision of "sustainable architecture, flawless engineering, and clean code". At the core of our founding philosophy lies the goal of transforming businesses' increasingly complex processes into end-to-end optimized, global-standard digital experiences. For us, software is not just a tool that solves immediate needs; it is a robust ecosystem that will carry the future growth strategies of companies.
story.p2: Today, with our deep expertise in modern application development standards and high-performance system architectures, we position projects not just as "working systems"; but as scalable, "future-ready" digital assets that provide stability under high traffic. Through our processes blended with type-safe programming languages and agile methodologies, we provide our business partners with digital transformation opportunities with the lowest risk and highest efficiency.

qa.title: Holistic Quality Assurance (QA) Protocol
qa.desc: Our uncompromising commitment to Test-Driven Development principles is the greatest guarantee of our zero-defect tolerance. Every single function unit written passes through multi-layered security, load, and regression tests before being included in the production line. Thanks to our Continuous Integration and Deployment automations; we promise our business partners an industrial-standard technology infrastructure free from technical debt, working flawlessly for years, and offering low maintenance costs.
